## PolicyRuleMatch.appRule property

The app rule whose `app` pattern matched the capability's app. This is the rule that provides the governing disposition (either directly via `disposition` or via an operation-level override in `operations`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly appRule: AppRule;
```
